US lawmakers urge participation in public life against 'anti-India hatred'

Several US lawmakers have called for active participation in public life to counter what they describe as 'anti-India hatred'. They emphasized that joining public discourse and civic engagement is crucial to combatting such sentiments. The lawmakers' statements were made in a context where they urged individuals to become more involved in the democratic process.
